summary: SK hynix Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, in response to a Korea Exchange disclosure inquiry regarding media reports that the company is considering building a semiconductor facility in Japan. The company clarifies that it is reviewing various measures, including establishing additional production bases, to strengthen its memory business competitiveness, but no matters have been determined as of the filing date. SK hynix commits to making a further disclosure when specific details are confirmed or within one month. This is a routine clarification response to a regulatory inquiry, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, prices, or structural details are provided. What to watch: whether SK hynix confirms any Japan facility investment plans in its follow-up disclosure.
